Messages.Author: Francois Gombault
Messages.Body:
Can Shape Mastery be played as a reaction card to cancel a combat card?

Ex: Meth-A's Gratiano enters combat with Meth-B's Igo the Hungry. Can I
(Meth-C) play Shape Mastery with my untapped Samantha to burn Gratiano's
Arms of the Abyss?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Francois Gombault wrote:
> Can Shape Mastery be played as a reaction card to cancel a combat card?

No. Reaction cards cannot be played in combat.

Messages.Author: Francois Gombault
Messages.Body:
LSJ wrote:
> No. Reaction cards cannot be played in combat.

Ah, found the reference in the rulebook.
"6.4. Combat
[...]
Note: The only minion cards that can be played during combat are combat
cards (unless a card states otherwise, of course)."

I thought maybe Shape Mastery (and Denial of Aphrodite's Favor) had
sufficient card text to allow this. Too bad.

--
